visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white cat with grey/black patches on its head and ears is perched on the lap of a person wearing a brown hoodie. The cat looks away with a slightly disgruntled facial expression. Text '不要煩我！' appears in the middle of the frame. (2) A hand enters the shot from the right and tries to stroke the cat's neck. The cat immediately pulls its head back and looks at the hand with squinted, annoyed eyes. The background is a simple indoor room with a white wall. (3) The camera angle remains at eye-level with the cat. The cat continues to dodge the owner's hand, which is trying to pet its head. Subtitles '不要過來' and '好了' appear sequentially. The cat's ears are slightly flattened. (4) Through a series of fast jump cuts, the hand keeps reaching for the cat, and the cat continues to move its head away sharply or swats at the hand. Emotional variety text '啊啊啊啊' and '妳走開！' are displayed. (5) The cat visibly protests by trying to bite or bat the hand away. The lighting is bright and even across the indoor scene. Text '吼呦' appears during a particularly reactive moment. (6) The interaction changes as the hand begins to massage the cat's chin and throat area thoroughly. The cat's face relaxes, its eyes close partially, and it begins to lean into the touch, showing enjoyment. Text '(好啦按摩按摩)' and '嗯嗯按摩可以' appear. (7) The video cuts to a solid pink background with the white logo '好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR' in the center.
